listing.title: My First At Home Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Things Around the House – Bed, Cup, Teapot, Bathtub & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book full of friendly things from around the house!

Little hands color 30 cute pages of everyday things toddlers see at home, from a smiling house and a bed with a sleepy pillow to a teapot, a toaster and a bathtub full of bubbles. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines, so small hands can color inside the lines, and each picture's name is written in big letters to color too.

Inside you'll find:

  • Around the house: House, Door, Window, Key, Mailbox and Flower Pot
  • In the rooms: Bed, Pillow, Chair, Table, Sofa, Lamp, Clock, Books and Mirror
  • In the kitchen: Cup, Teapot, Spoon, Pot, Toaster and Fridge
  • Bath time, bedtime and chores: Toothbrush, Bathtub, Towel, Soap, Potty, Slippers, Pajamas, Washing Machine and Broom
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5.

Part of the my first step series.
